† II. [נָצָה] vb. Niph. Hiph. struggle (NH id., Hithp. (Jastrow928); Aramaic נְצָא, ܢܨܳܐ quarrel; Arabic نَصَا apprehendit, arripuit aliquem antiis suis, Ethiopic ነጸየ vellere, evellere, are perhaps denom. from نَاصِيَةٌ (v. נוֹצָה), so Thes);—
Niph. recipr. struggle with each other: Impf. 3 mpl. יִנָּצוּ Ex 21:22 (E), Lv 24:10 (H), 2 S 14:6; יִנּ׳ יַחְדָּו Dt 25:11; Pt. נִצִּים Ex 2:13 (E); all of physical struggle, wrestling, and the like.
Hiph. engage in a struggle against: Pf. 3 pl. הִצּוּ Nu 26:9 (עַל); Inf. cstr. sf. הַצֹּתָם v 9 (עַל); הַצּוֹתוֹ אֶת ψ 60:2 (title); only here of war, hence Klo’s suggestion (cf. Buhl 13) הַכּוֹתוֹ is plausible (cf. 2 S 8:3, 5, 9).
